question: Within a 70 kilometers range, where can I find a café on the way to Freeman House Historic Site, VA from James Hite Park, Kearneysville, WV?
sql: SELECT pois.poi_name, pois.addr_state, pois.addr_city FROM pois WHERE pois.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin( pois.geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%James Hite Park%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Freeman House Historic Site%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 70000 );
